Class FrameGrabber

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.FrameGrabber
public final class FrameGrabber extends Object
Reads the rendered frame back from the GPU through the same device calls vanilla's screenshot code uses, so it works on whatever graphics backend the game runs on. Read-back is asynchronous: a request made after one frame is delivered a frame or so later, and at most one is in flight. Everything here runs on the render thread.

    • copy

      private com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture copy
      While each frame is drawn twice (see KeyedSkin.setTwoPass(boolean)): a copy of the agent's picture, made the moment it is complete. The game then draws the player's picture over the original, and a read-back that a graphics driver carries out later than it was asked for would hand the agent that one. The copy is nobody else's, so it cannot change under the read-back.
